aliases.human_text: The monks must use these as mounts. Pretty useful!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: What are you talking about? The face is totally off...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: ...and my figure is much, much better!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Actually, these are idols that the Ancients built some eons ago.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: It's said that if certain trials are passed, a great power may be given...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Why not give it a try?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Hey, don't these statues look an awful lot like you?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: And if they can weaken the seal, I can strengthen it!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Then that's where we'll strike. If the cult can take the temples, I can take them back.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: I'm not here for a tour, Rene.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Edward said he's going to open the Forbidden Seal; I need to know why... and how to stop him.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: I see... so that's why he threw out the church and took the temples...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Welcome to the Great Sanctuary, Lord $player. Alastor himself blessed these grounds... we will be safe here.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Like you, Edward knew that the church's power stemmed from the great temples and the faeries within...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Even now, his minions must be in our temples, weakening the seal with their dark rituals...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Alastor be praised! I will give you the location of our temples.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Now go forth, Lord $player. The Earthlight Temple lies to the south... and may Alastor watch over you.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Good, your spirit is ready. Now, listen to me carefully, Lord $player...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Just as faerie energy is the source of life, Dark Energy is the source of destruction.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: If Edward has truly mastered the Dark Arts, then the Forbidden Seal must not fall into his hands.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Should the Forbidden Seal be opened, all the Dark Energy in the world would be his to command!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Is this... truly the Great Sanctuary? And the Order of Alastor?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Yes. Or what remains of us.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: But as Alastor will return, so too shall we. Have hope, Lord $player.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Everyone is counting on you, Lord $player!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Many come to this place to pay respect to the faeries of the land.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: It is said that under the right circumstances, those that pray to their statues may see certain visions...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: The Templars were nearly invincible, but they were bound to the king's will.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Once the king disbanded them, the church fell to the cult instantly.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Edward must have used his magic to compel the king... such terrible power.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Search the Darkwood and reach the Earthlight Temple.

aliases.human_text: You really don't understand, do you, $player?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: I never thought Edward would go so far. Corrupting the land, expelling the church... even using the Dark Arts!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: What could have driven him to such depths?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Master Rene has left to gather the Templars. I know he wishes you luck in your quest.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Don't worry, Rene. I'll set things right.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Once the Forbidden Seal is fully closed, Edward's powers will weaken.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: If we can regather the Templars, reclaiming Gothicus should be well within your power.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Ha... ha... you've done well, $player. But your time draws near...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Heh heh... the... the throne is... overturned... all is... over...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: The end times... Alastor's return... Alastor's.... Al....

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: He's gone. Don't pay any attention to what he said, $player. It's just the ramblings of a dying man.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Come on, something tells me that we don't have much time.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: What do you mean? Explain yourself... there's no point in holding back now.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: He said that the church has moved against the throne. That must mean Rene...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: You have the eyes of a falcon, $player. I shall enjoy cutting them out of you.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: So it shall be. The church has made its move against the throne. All will end.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Talk is pointless, now. All that's left is to settle our scores.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: This is the last time, Alu-Vidor, I swear it.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Wait, what are you talking about?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Go to Gothicus Castle and investigate the situation.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Defeat the assassin within the Great Sanctuary.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource

aliases.human_text: Search the Great Sanctuary for survivors.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Rene! Are you there?! Answer me!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: What have I done? I've brought this on them. I've condemned them all!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: The Templar said that Rene fled east to the Fallen Kingdom. They must be holding a faerie there.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Then we haven't much time. Let's go.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: We don't want anyone's life. We're only here to stop the church from taking your energy.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: They're trying to summon the Dark Queen to bring about Alastor's judgment.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: This little one is only a child. He's only following my command. Take my life instead!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: The church? ... I see. So those humans were members of the church. I felt much Dark Energy in them.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: The judgment?! Again?! Truly, what foolish beings you humans are.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Even with the ruins of the Ancients about you, you seek to repeat that tragedy...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Very well. I am Sylph, faerie of the winds. I shall give you my aid.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: I have the faerie, brother. That's all that matters.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Master Rene! We have the faerie!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: W... wait! Take the faerie! Take everything! We don't want a fight!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: No, please! Stop! I beg you!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Our mounts... they're gone! They've returned to the Fallen Kingdom... we've been abandoned!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: You filthy humans... you're all alike...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: You care only for power... you spill blood like it's water...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: And you dare to spill it on my land!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Come, Tyrant of the skies! Turn these humans to dust!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: If that's the case, we should be very careful. There isn't a faerie in the world that likes intruders.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: This is the power of the air faerie. She's held this city above the clouds for over a thousand years...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Incredible... So this is how this realm survived Alastor's judgment...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Boiling seas and raging fires wouldn't have any effect above the clouds.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Okay, stay on guard. Let's go.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: $player! If they get away, it's over! Stop them!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: You're too late, sons of Gothicus! This faerie is ours!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Ha ha ha! With this, the judgment is inevitable! Ha ha ha!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Explore the Bloodsands and find the Fallen Kingdom.

aliases.human_text: So the wheel of fate has ground to a halt at last...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: But perhaps this, too, has been preordained...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: The world of Alastor is over... now begins a new chapter...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: It's all up to you now, $player.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Go on. Your friends are waiting for you.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Now get out of here. I won't need steel or spells anymore.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: None have escaped the wheel of fate! None have escaped judgment!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Now their flesh and bones litter the space between stars... their souls litter the halls of the void!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Join your brethren, insect! Become as dust!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Ha ha ha... I have no intention of hiding, $player...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Indeed, I am all around you... I am always around you, always watching!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Stay alive, hero. Perhaps we will meet again...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: It seems that you're everywhere we go. Just who are you?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: As I thought, they wanted to create a new world by summoning the Dark Queen.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: They'll have Alastor burn this world to the ground, just like the Ancients did.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Heh. I never wanted a new world, brother... just a world without you.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: I never needed the Dark Queen for that... just enough Dark Energy to destroy you.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Does that bother you? Ha ha ha! It's only a joke, a joke! Ha ha ha!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Come, there will be more Templars ahead. Try not to get killed! Ha ha ha!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: How's this any different than what you wanted?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: It looks like there was a battle. We're on the right track.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: We are sons of Gothicus! Do you dare raise your weapons against us?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Halt! In the name of Alastor, surrender!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: We know who you are, $player of Gothicus. You immortals have ruled over us for too long...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: But when the final battle comes, there will be a new world! One free of immortals like you!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Hold, stranger! I am no enemy of yours... only a meager pilgrim!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Legend tells of Alastor's coming and his judgment on the Ancients...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: We must all reject the Dark Arts or our fates will be the same as theirs!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: May Alastor's blessing be upon you, stranger!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Alastor alone protects us from the darkness...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: I saw some men in dark robes run into a cave...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: I see... So they won't accept Alastor...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: It seemed that they were afraid of that dark shadow overhead...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Then they will suffer in the eternal void. Those poor fools...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Those men are wicked. They need Alastor in their life.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Those who use the Dark Arts will be punished. Those who accept the Dark Queen will be destroyed!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Did the Ancient King's spirit appear to you?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: That is the lesson of the Ancients!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: No? Then you must have darkness within you. Be gone!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Oh? You wish to know more of the ancient lore?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Then you must pay tribute at the grave of the Ancient King. His spirit will whisper the tales of old...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: The Templars chased us on great dragons...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: So you took our vengeance for us... I see...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: They picked us off one by one! Like animals!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Then we shall meet again in the great void. Ha ha ha ha!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Please, take revenge on them for us! Kill them all!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Enjoy your gold, stranger. That is the only wealth you'll have in this world.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: It's said that they are descendants of noble blood and hide great wealth within their lairs...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Oh? Do you still covet wealth and power? Then go and search for the gold. You will find only pain.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Search for the missing cultists in the caverns of The Frost Comb.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Leave a prayer for the Ancient King within the Icemurk Dellion.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource

aliases.human_text: Collect the Barbarian treasure within the caverns of the Frost Comb.

aliases.human_text: Do you believe him, $player? It could be a trap.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Ha ha ha... I suppose you think that there's nothing in the Northerlands but snow and barbarians?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Heh heh... I can see why Rene fooled you so easily.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Very well. Beyond these mountains, a faerie from the ancient world sleeps amid the clouds...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: The church may already have enough Dark Energy to summon the Dark Queen's body...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: But they'll need faerie energy to give her life. If they're after faeries, this is where they'll be.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Ha ha ha... Well, you don't have to believe me, just follow me. Not that you have a choice! Ha ha ha!

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Alright Edward. I've followed you this far. What are we doing here?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: I wouldn't put it past him, but we don't have any other leads.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Let's follow for now... but keep an eye out.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Say what you will, Edward. Just tell us why we're here.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: All we need to do is get the faeries before the church does, brother.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Come, it's only a bit further.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: This is what waits for us if the Dark Queen returns.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Look at these bodies, $player. They're being transformed...

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Do you think it could be the gas? And this rift?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Maybe it's best not to think about it. Come on, let's go, $player.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: If that's true, then these monsters we've been fighting... Could they really be...?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Y-you're not seriously thinking about going inside, are you?

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text: Do you hear that down there? It almost sounds like... a voice.

aliases.human_text:
Faeries are the source of magic in the realm. Every faerie is bound to one of the five elements: fire, air, water, earth, or lightning. You can only equip one faerie at a time.

The five elements compose the source of all spells and magical creatures. Every elemental creature has strengths and weaknesses against one or more of these elements.

aliases.human_text:
Character Points are awarded when you level up. Allocating points to your various attributes will result in the following improvements:

^3Strength ^rimproves your damage and ability to wear heavy armor.

^3Dexterity ^rimproves your ability to hit enemies with weapons, score critical hits, and dodge enemy attacks.

^3Endurance ^rimproves your character's ability to resist attacks. It also increases your character's health and chances of blocking attacks.

^3Energy ^rimproves your equipped faerie's spell strength, your character's elemental resistance, and total mana.

aliases.human_text:
^3Level: ^rRepresents your character's overall power.

^3Experience (EXP): ^rThe amount of experience points your character has gained for the current level.

^3HP: ^rThese are your character's health points. When HP falls to 0, your character dies.

^3MP: ^rThese are your character's mana points. MP can be spent to use class skills and cast magic.

^3Attack Rating (AR): ^rRepresents your character's ability to hit enemies with melee weapons.

^3Defense Rating (DR): ^rRepresents your character's ability to defend against melee attacks.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text:
^3R-Dam./L-Dam.: ^rThis is the damage your character deals with the weapons currently equipped in right and left hands. Elemental damage is displayed next to it.

^3Armor: ^rThis is the total armor value of all your character's equipped gear.

^3Dodge: ^rRepresents your character's ability to avoid melee attacks.

^3Block: ^rRepresents your character's average chances of blocking attacks. Damage taken is greatly reduced on a successful block.

^3Crit: ^rRepresents your character's average chances of dealing double damage with a successful melee attack.

^3Spell Hit: ^rRepresents your character's average chances of hitting with magic.

aliases.evidence: Exact symbol row in indexed source resource
aliases.human_text:
^3Spell Crit: ^rRepresents your character's average chances of dealing double damage with magic.

^3Spell Penetration: ^rRepresents your character's average chances of penetrating an enemy's resistance when using magic.

^3HP and MP Leech: ^rWhen dealing melee damage while gear with leech ability is equipped, a fraction of the damage dealt is returned to your character's HP or MP.

^3HP and MP Regeneration: ^rRepresents the rate at which your character recovers HP and MP.

^3Resistances: ^rRepresents your resistances to each of the five elemental types of damage.

aliases.human_text:
To equip any piece of equipment, you must meet certain requirements. Allocate character points (awarded after leveling up) in order to meet those requirements.

There are three types of weapons: one-handed weapons, off-hand weapons, and two-handed weapons. Equip two-handed weapons to deal bonus damage. Equip two weapons at once to double your attack rate (however, you will receive an attack rating penalty).

Many items have magical properties. The color of the item's name indicates the number of magical properties the item has.

^0White^r = No magical properties
^1Green^r = 1 magical property
^2Blue^r = 2 magical properties
^3Purple^r = 3 magical properties
^4Gold^r = 4 magical properties

Ci sono tre tipi di armi: armi a una mano, armi secondarie e armi a due mani. Usando un'arma a due mani, riceverai un bonus ai danni inflitti. Usando due armi, il tuo livello d'attacco diminuirà ma il numero degli attacchi raddoppierà.

Molti oggetti possiedono proprietà magiche. Il colore del nome dell'oggetto rappresenta il numero di proprietà magiche possedute dall'oggetto stesso.

^0Bianco^r = nessuna proprietà magica
^1Verde^r = 1 proprietà magica
^2Blu^r = 2 proprietà magiche
^3Viola^r = 3 proprietà magiche
^4Oro^r = 4 proprietà magiche

nodes.english_text:
Gothicus, land of fear, land... of destiny.
Now comes a tale born of sorrow and blood;
The tale of a kingdom condemned by the gods, doomed to dark times in the age of two sons.
Two sons cursed with the strength of immortals,
Two sons, cursed by the dread fate of kings.
Armies are raised. Dark powers awake. 
And one prince comes to power on a tide of new evil.
But the true tale of sorrow has only begun.
Let this new chapter of Gothicus
Be written in fire...

nodes.name:
Todas las armas y armaduras tienen requisitos para poder ser equipadas. Puedes alcanzar estos requisitos asignando puntos de personaje (obtenidos al subir de nivel).

Hay tres tipos de armas: armas a una mano, armas para la mano izquierda y armas a dos manos. Cuando usas armas a dos manos, recibes una bonificación del daño que infliges. Cuando usas dos armas, recibes una penalización al ataque, pero doblas el número de ataques.

Muchos objetos tienen propiedades mágicas. El color del objeto representa el número de propiedades mágicas que posee.

^0Blanco^r = sin propiedades mágicas
^1Verde^r = 1 propiedad mágica
^2Azul^r = 2 propiedades mágicas
^3Violeta^r = 3 propiedades mágicas
^4Dorado^r = 4 propiedades mágicas

nodes.name:
Gothicus, land of fear, land... of destiny.
Now comes a tale born of sorrow and blood;
The tale of a kingdom condemned by the gods, doomed to dark times in the age of two sons.
Two sons cursed with the strength of immortals,
Two sons, cursed by the dread fate of kings.
Armies are raised. Dark powers awake. 
And one prince comes to power on a tide of new evil.
But the true tale of sorrow has only begun.
Let this new chapter of Gothicus
Be written in fire...

Є три типи зброї: одноручна, ліворучна і дворучна. Використовуйте дворучну зброю, щоб завдавати більшої шкоди. Екіпіруйте дві зброї одночасно, щоб подвоїти швидкість атаки (але ви отримаєте штраф до ПА).

Багатьох предметів наділено магічними властивостями. Колір назви предмета вказує на кількість його магічних властивостей.

^0Білий^r = Немає магічних властивостей
^1Зелений^r = 1 магічна властивість
^2Синій^r = 2 магічні властивості
^3Фіолетовий^r = 3 магічні властивості
^4Золотий^r = 4 магічні властивості

Очки персонажа нараховуються при підвищенні рівня. Розподіл очок за характеристиками призведе до наступних поліпшень:

^3Сила ^rпідвищує шкоду і здатність носити важку броню.

^3Спритність ^rпідвищує здатність потрапляти по ворогах, завдавати критичні удари й ухилятися від ворожих атак.

^3Витривалість ^rпідвищує здатність персонажа чинити опір атакам. Вона також збільшує здоров'я персонажа і шанси блокувати атаки.

^3Енергія ^rпідвищує силу заклинань екіпірованої феї, опір стихіям персонажа і загальну кількість мани.

nodes.name:
To equip any piece of equipment, you must meet certain requirements. Allocate character points (awarded after leveling up) in order to meet those requirements.

There are three types of weapons: one-handed weapons, off-hand weapons, and two-handed weapons. Equip two-handed weapons to deal bonus damage. Equip two weapons at once to double your attack rate (however, you will receive an attack rating penalty).

Many items have magical properties. The color of the item's name indicates the number of magical properties the item has.

^0White^r = No magical properties
^1Green^r = 1 magical property
^2Blue^r = 2 magical properties
^3Purple^r = 3 magical properties
^4Gold^r = 4 magical properties

^3Ловкость ^rповышает способность попадать по врагам, наносить критические удары и уклоняться от вражеских атак.

^3Выносливость ^rповышает способность персонажа сопротивляться атакам. Она также увеличивает здоровье персонажа и шансы блокировать атаки.

^3Энергия ^rповышает силу заклинаний экипированной феи, сопротивление стихиям персонажа и общее количество маны.

nodes.english_text:
To equip any piece of equipment, you must meet certain requirements. Allocate character points (awarded after leveling up) in order to meet those requirements.

There are three types of weapons: one-handed weapons, off-hand weapons, and two-handed weapons. Equip two-handed weapons to deal bonus damage. Equip two weapons at once to double your attack rate (however, you will receive an attack rating penalty).

Many items have magical properties. The color of the item's name indicates the number of magical properties the item has.

^0White^r = No magical properties
^1Green^r = 1 magical property
^2Blue^r = 2 magical properties
^3Purple^r = 3 magical properties
^4Gold^r = 4 magical properties
